citations.desc: Institutional Animal Care and Use Committee (IACUC).
citations.narrative:
Between January 2026 and October 2026, the IACUC held 3 meetings. An unaffiliated member was not present for those
meetings. In addition, an unaffiliated member was not involved in the semi-annual facility inspection and program review
conducted during that time. The lack of participation of an unaffiliated IACUC member in IACUC meetings and semi-
annuals means that there is a lack of general community interest being represented on the committee regarding proper
care and treatment of animals at the facility. The IACUC, when conducting business required under the Animal Welfare
Act, shall include at least one member unaffiliated with the facility. Correct by February 19, 2027.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with facility representatives.
You may appeal all or part of any inspection report by submitting a written statement contesting the findings—along with
any supporting documentation—to the Deputy Administrator. Appeals of routine, focused, or attempted inspections must
be received within 21 days of report issuance as shown by the signature line of this report.
Appeals may be sent by email to AnimalCare@usda.gov.
Appeals sent by mail should be addressed to:
Deputy Administrator
APHIS Animal Care (AC)
U.S. Department of Agriculture
2150 Centre Avenue, Building B
Mailstop #3W11
Fort Collins, CO 80526-8117
